claims: Cori Close is the head coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
Cori Close has held the position of head coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team since April 2011.
Cori Close is The Michael Price Family UCLA Women's Head Basketball Coach.
Cori Close led the UCLA Women's Basketball team to their first-ever NCAA National Championship in 2026.
The UCLA Women's Basketball team defeated South Carolina 79-51 in the 2026 NCAA National Championship.
Cori Close has surpassed 300 wins at UCLA.
Cori Close is only the third coach in UCLA women's basketball program history to surpass 300 wins.
The UCLA Women's Basketball team won the 2026 NCAA Division I women's basketball championship.
Cori Close led the UCLA Women's Basketball team to the 2015 WNIT Championship.
Cori Close was named the 2025 Naismith Women's College Coach of the Year.
Cori Close was named the 2025 USBWA Coach of the Year.
Cori Close was an associate head coach at Florida State before joining UCLA.
Cori Close played at UC Santa Barbara.
